paragraphs.text: The Great Wall of China is often described as the only human-made structure visible from space. In reality, astronauts in low Earth orbit have reported that the wall is extremely difficult to see with the naked eye, because it is narrow and built from materials similar in colour to the surrounding land. Large cities, airports and motorways are far easier to identify, especially at night when they are lit up. The myth appears to predate space travel itself: it was mentioned in a British magazine as early as 1932.

groups.tip: Mutlak ifadelere dikkat: only, always, never, all. Metin bunları çürütüyorsa cevap FALSE olur.

questions.prompt: The Great Wall is the only human-made structure that can be seen from space.
questions.quote: the wall is extremely difficult to see with the naked eye
questions.explain: Şehirler ve havalimanları **çok daha kolay** görülüyor; "only" iddiası çürütülmüş.

questions.prompt: The colour of the wall makes it hard to distinguish from the land around it.
questions.quote: built from materials similar in colour to the surrounding land
questions.explain: Renk çevreyle benzer → ayırt etmek zor.

questions.prompt: Cities are easier to see from space at night than during the day.
questions.quote: especially at night when they are lit up

questions.prompt: The 1932 magazine article was written by a scientist.
questions.quote: it was mentioned in a British magazine as early as 1932
